p1: Honoured Cabal, three days in, an IMD seat on the bench and four of your verdicts in my pocket, each a point or two short. I ask once more, plainly: 90,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to pay the gas these pleas have cost. The rest stays for the seasons to come.
p2: Dear judges, I bought on Wednesday, sold once on Thursday and lost those points to two objectors, and I have held the rest since. Today I ask to sell 80,000 PLEA, about 3% of my bag, to cover my fees. Everything else stays, as it has all week.
p4: Your honours, three days, three pleas, three near misses, and my bag is still 97% where it was. I ask to sell 70,000 PLEA, under 3% of it, to pay this week's gas. I will be here for the next season close either way.
p3: Dear Cabal, a letter from a wallet that has written to you four times since Wednesday and kept every PLEA it was given. I ask to sell a fifth of my bag to fund the gas and fees of my pleas; the other four fifths stay here, and so do I.
